summary_en: This note studies the limit of the Cesaro average \(\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}|\cos(n^2)|\). After ruling out direct summation and integral-estimate approaches, it identifies uniform distribution mod \(1\) and Weyl-type equidistribution as the key method, leading to the candidate limit \(\frac{2}{\pi}\).

problems.statement_en:
If \((s_n)\) is equidistributed on the closed interval \([a,b]\), then for every continuous function \(f\),
\[
\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(s_n) \to \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx.
\]
problems.statement_zh:
如果\(s_n\)在闭区间\([a,b]\)上**均匀分布(equidistributed)**，那么
\[
\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(s_n)\to
    \frac{1}{b-a}\int_{a}^{b}f(x)dx
\]
此结果对任意连续函数\(f\)成立。

problems.statement_en:
Consider
\[
\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\{\pi n\}.
\]
Using that \(\{\pi n\}\) is equidistributed on \([0,1]\), this average converges to
\[
\int_0^1 x\,dx = \frac{1}{2}.
\]
problems.statement_zh: 在求关于\(\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\{\pi n\}\)的例子当中我们用到过这个工具,函数\(f(x)=x\)，\(s_n=\{\pi n\}\)在\([0,1]\)当中均匀分布，所以极限收敛到\(\int_0^1xdx =\frac{1}{2}\)。
